source_documents: User attachment: three fully formed praxis candidates
User attachment: E0 through E4 development experiment sequence

primary_program.question: When does observable telemetry quality justify using graph context instead of a feature-only detector?
primary_program.scope_note: The supplied E0-E4 sequence tests a telemetry-quality routing proposal. It is not a complete implementation or validation of all three separate candidate tracks.

candidates.title: Disconnected local LLM detection and reconstruction
candidates.problem: Security teams need useful analysis when audit telemetry cannot leave the network.
candidates.research_question: Can a completely local pipeline preserve campaign detection and evidence-grounded reconstruction on held-out environments within a fixed hardware and latency budget?
candidates.novelty_claim_rejected: First local open-weight or Qwen-based APT analysis pipeline
candidates.potential_contribution: An independently evaluated quality-cost boundary under verified offline runtime dependencies and campaign-held-out evaluation.
readiness_gates: Inspect and reproduce OCR-APT's existing local-model comparison
Pin labels, campaign splits, reference code, and resource budget
Test language-model and embedding replacements separately
Justify and freeze noninferiority margin before evaluation
Verify inference and all runtime dependencies work with network access disabled

candidates.title: Dependable alerts across detector retraining
candidates.problem: Retraining may change which attacks and ordinary activities trigger alerts.
candidates.research_question: Can a frozen reliability intervention reduce prediction disagreement and adverse alert burden without sacrificing campaign detection at matched cost?
candidates.novelty_claim_rejected: First study or tooling to measure provenance-detector seed instability
candidates.potential_contribution: A specific intervention with paired decision-level reliability metrics, analyst escalation accounting, and independent transfer evidence.
candidate_datasets: DARPA TC through pinned PIDSMaker release
readiness_gates: Reproduce two systems before expanding the matrix
Separate training randomness, threshold fitting, data ordering, and environment shift
Use ordinary ensemble and threshold controls at equal total cost
Count abstention and analyst escalation explicitly
Require useful mean detection while reducing disagreement
Keep campaign uncertainty separate from seed variability

candidates.title: Structural and semantic evidence for rare attack stages
candidates.problem: Strong overall traffic scores can hide missed rare attack stages.
candidates.research_question: At equal information access and independent campaign splits, do semantic or hybrid representations improve prespecified rare-stage detection beyond graph and strong tabular baselines?
candidates.novelty_claim_rejected: Semantic graph enrichment or Qwen plus a GNN is itself new
candidates.potential_contribution: A controlled analysis separating representation, graph information, class balancing, and cross-environment failure boundaries.
candidate_datasets: S-DAPT-2026 subject to release and task audit
candidates.primary_graph_reference: GIN from the historical same-procedure corrective experiment
readiness_gates: Obtain exact data and validate stage labels and independent campaign identifiers
Define minority stages using training information or domain definitions
Audit stage-name and identifier leakage in text templates and alert types
Equalize information available to representation arms
Apply balancing only to training data with meaningful within-family controls
Freeze cross-dataset taxonomy mapping and distinguish alerts from raw flows

global_claim_boundaries: No new candidate is established novel or empirically successful by this registry
No original GML publication status is asserted
Public benchmark ground truth still requires local validation
Thirty positive records is a proposed screen and does not establish statistical power
E2 development results cannot serve as independent confirmation of an E3 policy selected on them
Undefined benefit ratios must be reported as null with a reason
Oracle use of evaluation labels is diagnostic only and must not influence deployable policies or random control rates
